newsitem.title: UK: Smith and Nephew down on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Smith and Nephew down on profit-taking.

text.p: Shares in Smith and Nephew Plc were among the biggest percentage losers in the FTSE 100 index on Monday on profit-taking after recent strong gains, traders said.
Shares in the healthcare firm were down 4-1/4p or 2.2 percent at 191-3/4p by 1055 GMT, after Friday's squeeze left the stock up 8p at 196p.
Friday's rally came after newspaper speculation that the firm was the target of a takeover bid.
"There's been profit taking. I think a few people were quite badly burnt by the stock," one market-maker said.
Other news contributing to the stock's fall include worries over the strong pound and U.S. and UK health budgets, one Sunday newspaper said.
Analysts should take rumours of bid speculation with a pinch of salt the paper added, "The shares offer value for the patient."
